ops.title: stack submit: a held branch at a superseded published head is pinned, not diverged
ops.body: PR #383 (2026-10-12): stack submit pins only branches another ccx lane holds (ForeignBranchHolders), so a parent held by a same-lane working copy at a pre-rewrite head was a run member and stackSnapshot refused it as diverged. stackPlan now pins any branch another working copy holds when its local head is reachable from its remote-tracking reflog and not ahead of origin (stackHeldSuperseded). A broader rule inside stackSnapshot (take remote whenever the remote reflog reaches the local head) broke TestStackSubmitRefusesARemoteRewriteAfterPublication, TestStackRebaseParentDropsTheQueuesReplayOfALandedParent and TestStackSnapshotComparesAServerRestackOntoARestackedParentByPatch: a rewrite of a branch this working copy holds must still refuse.
